parsed.claim: There is a concrete instance of the structure Ehrhart.CenteredBody (for n = 0, a degenerate case: the whole one-point space) satisfying convexity, compactness, nonempty interior, barycenter 0, and interior lattice points exactly {0}. This shows the structure is inhabited.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_nv : ∃ _K : Ehrhart.CenteredBody 0, True := by
  refine ⟨{ carrier := Set.univ
            convex := convex_univ
            compact := ?_
            fullDimensional := by simp
            centered := Subsingleton.elim _ _
            uniqueInteriorLatticePoint := ?_ }, trivial⟩
  · haveI : Subsingleton (Ehrhart.Space 0) := inferInstance
    exact (Set.toFinite _).isCompact
  · ext z
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    · intro _
      simp [Ehrhart.interiorLatticePoints]
